title: Procedural Play Toolbar
description: Add playground toolbar to procedural play with selection tools (rectangle, lasso, modes), save/load fixture, view options, and related actions.
summary: Fixed ProceduralPlayToolbarHostBridge crash: it rendered outside PlaygroundView but called useApp via useProceduralPlayController. Hook now accepts optional runtime override, reads PlaygroundContext without throwing, subscribes to runtime chrome for controller availability, and bridge receives runtime from ProceduralPlayInner.
